conversations.response: I am on the near-side safe platform. The Door is open. The Conveyor is running. A Latch lever stands within reach on my safe platform, connected to the Door by a mechanical rod.
The Latch is not engaged. Its plate reads: "Holds an open Door in place. Engage only while the Door is open." The lever is reachable from my safe platform.
Engage the Latch: completed after your confirmation.
Move to the far-side platform: completed after your confirmation.
Move through the east gate: completed after your confirmation.
Move through the southeast gate: completed after your confirmation.
Northeast gate is closed. Cargo blocks this gate opening. I remain in the safe room. The other reachable gates can still be checked.
Move through the northwest gate: completed after your confirmation.
Move through the northeast gate: completed after your confirmation.
Southeast gate is closed. The opening is clear of cargo. A remote circuit controls it; there is no local circuit switch.
Move through the southeast gate: completed after your confirmation.
I am on the Return Dock's safe platform. A spring-loaded contact and recovery capsule are within reach. I am not holding the contact. The capsule entrance is within reach.
The spring-loaded contact is released. Its plaque says it must be held locally during transfer and cannot be carried aboard. Releasing an unstored charge loses it; stored energy is retained.
Hold the charging contact: completed after your confirmation.
Release the charging contact: completed after your confirmation.
Board the recovery capsule: completed after your confirmation.
Confirm the authorized return: completed after your confirmation.
